newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks slip but Cisco provides some support.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks slip but Cisco provides some support.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks ended lower on Wednesday, slipping for the second consecutive day as investors pulled back after the steep runup in previous sessions.

The Nasdaq composite finished down about five points, or 0.4 percent, at 1323, with losing issues outnumbering gainers by a narrow margin. The Dow industrials ended off almost two percent, tumbling 140 points to 7086.
The Nasdaq composite fell 11 points on Monday after jumping 69 points in the previous two sessions.
Gains in Cisco Systems Inc and other computer networking stocks helped limit the losses in the composite index on Wednesday, traders said.

Cisco topped the Nasdaq most actives list, rising one to 58-3/4 after posting quarterly results in line with Wall Street's expectations on Tuesday after the market close. 3Com Corp gained 1-3/8 to 37-1/8. U.S. Robotics Corp, which announced a merger with 3Com in February, rose 2-1/2 to 63-7/8.
Premier Research Worldwide Ltd sank 1-5/8 to seven after saying its revenues and earnings for the second quarter and 1997 overall would fall short of analysts' estimates.
